title: Highest individual ODI score
description: Rohit Sharma's 264 remains the highest individual score in men's ODI cricket.

title: Three ODI double centuries
description: The only batter to score three ODI double centuries.

title: Most centuries in a single World Cup
description: Five centuries in the 2019 Cricket World Cup, a tournament record at the time.

title: T20I centuries
description: Finished his T20I career with five centuries.

title: IPL titles as captain
description: Led Mumbai Indians to five IPL titles: 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019 and 2020.
